stat: Cost per tracked AI-visibility prompt per month across three named UK-available vendors' entry and growth tiers
unit: GBP per tracked prompt per month
method: Recipe D (cost-per-outcome ratio across vendors) — dividing each vendor's published monthly price by its included prompt count, after sterling conversion
workings: Sterling conversion at approximate July 2026 FX rates ($1 = £0.75, EUR1 = £0.845, consistent with prior stat_bank entries). Otterly Lite $29/mo / 15 prompts = £21.75 / 15 = £1.45 per prompt/month. Otterly Standard $189/mo / 100 prompts = £141.75 / 100 = £1.42. Semrush AI Visibility Toolkit $99/mo add-on / 25 prompts = £74.25 / 25 = £2.97. Peec AI Starter EUR89/mo / 25 prompts = £75.21 / 25 = £3.01. Peec AI Pro EUR199/mo / 100 prompts = £168.16 / 100 = £1.68. Range across all five tiers: £1.42 (cheapest, Otterly Standard) to £3.01 (priciest, Peec Starter). None of the three vendors publish this per-prompt figure themselves.
